# Third-party notices

These texts come from the exact dependency versions referenced by the pinned Ghostty source.
Each file records its original archive or source URL.
They do not change the application's license or relicense bundled components.

The release includes these texts and the SwiftPM package license/NOTICE files in `Contents/Resources/ThirdPartyNotices.txt`.
The FreeType portions are used under the FreeType License rather than its alternative GPL terms.
GNU gettext's LGPL runtime retains its own terms.
Signed releases also include `Macuake-source-materials.zip`, containing the committed app source, pinned Ghostty integration source, and checksum-verified GNU gettext 0.24 source.
The app can be relinked with a rebuilt library using the ad-hoc local-library build option without the maintainer's private signing key.
